versions.content: The Fr module’s implementer shall replace all prefixes Fr within the Fr specification by a vendor specific prefix Fr_<Vendor Id>_<Vendor specific name> during implementation to allow the usage of different FlexRay Drivers within one build system. The Fr module’s implementer shall apply this rule to all prefixes within filenames, Fr module specific datatypes, Fr module specific constants, Fr module specific global variables and API functions.
